title: Evaluation of the Cyclic Completion Tree
statement: Let the sign alphabet be $\{-1,1\}$, let $s\in\{0,1,2\}$, and let $a$ be a sign. Define $b$ and $c$ as the next and following indices in cyclic order modulo $3$ starting from $s$. For any sign vector $x$ on these three indices, evaluating the completion tree with seed $s$ and known value $a$ gives $a$ if $a=x_b$, and gives $x_c$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is one of the three indices
$x$ assigns a sign to each of the three indices
